Alchemist: Razzil Darkbrew, an ambitious chemist, transformed a captured ogre into his volatile partner in pursuit of the ultimate alchemical formula.
Axe: Mogul Khan rose through the Red Mist army by cutting down enemies and rivals alike, eventually becoming its sole surviving commander.
Bristleback: Rigwarl is a brawler whose notorious temper and thorn-covered back earned him both a reputation and his name.
Centaur Warrunner: Bradwarden fought his way out of the Omexe arenas, seeking greater battles beyond their walls.

Clockwerk: Rattletrap built himself an ingenious suit of war machinery after conflict destroyed his family’s livelihood.
Dawnbreaker: Valora is a celestial warrior forged to defend the light, wielding her hammer against darkness across the stars.
Doom: Lucifer, once a powerful being of the realm beyond, was cast down and now spreads ruin through mortal lands.
Dragon Knight: Davion, a dragon hunter, became bound to the ancient dragon Slyrak and gained the power to transform.
Earth Spirit: Kaolin is a living fragment of the earth, awakened from sacred stone to bring balance to the world.

Huskar: Saved from death, Huskar discovered that pain and sacrifice could fuel a devastating form of spiritual power.
Kunkka: Admiral Kunkka commands the remnants of a legendary fleet, still haunted by his battle with the demons of the deep.
Largo: A mysterious newcomer to the battlefield whose story unfolds amid Dota's ever-expanding world.

Lifestealer: N’aix was imprisoned for a lifetime and fused with a powerful spirit, emerging as a ravenous predator.

Mars: The son of a war god grew weary of his father's endless conflicts and now seeks glory on his own terms.
Night Stalker: Balanar is a predator from the world’s first nights, when darkness held dominion over creation.
Ogre Magi: Aggron Stonebreak possesses little conventional wisdom but is blessed with astonishing and unlikely luck.

Phoenix: An ancient stellar being cycles through fiery death and rebirth, traveling between worlds like a living sun.
Primal Beast: A monstrous creature from an ancient world, the Primal Beast lives by sheer ferocity and destructive instinct.
Pudge: The Butcher of the Flayed Lands delights in collecting the remains of his victims with his terrible hook.
Slardar: A guardian of the deep, Slardar rises from underwater kingdoms to protect secrets hidden beneath the waves.
Spirit Breaker: Barathrum charged out of the spirit realm, driven to hunt a quarry across the boundaries of existence.
Sven: Born between two worlds, Sven rejected his order's strict code and fights as a wandering rogue knight.
Tidehunter: Leviathan is a colossal sea warrior whose feud with Admiral Kunkka follows him from the ocean’s depths.
Timbersaw: Rizzrack survived an assault by trees and became obsessed with destroying forests using his mechanical saw-suit.
Tiny: Once a humble stone giant, Tiny continues growing as he seeks to learn where he came from.
Treant Protector: Rooftrellen guards an ancient forest and reluctantly leaves its shelter when nature is threatened.
Tusk: Ymir, a renowned tavern brawler, travels the world in search of fights worthy of his extraordinary strength.
Underlord: Vrogros commands armies from the depths of the Abyss, planning to conquer the surface world.
Undying: Dirge returned from a terrible tomb neither fully alive nor dead, compelled to spread decay and dread.
Wraith King: King Ostarion sacrificed countless souls in a ritual to defy mortality and rule beyond death.
Anti-Mage: After witnessing his monastery destroyed by magic, the Anti-Mage dedicated his life to hunting spellcasters.
Bloodseeker: Strygwyr serves the Flayed Twins, hunting victims to feed their terrible appetite for blood.
Bounty Hunter: Gondar rose from the streets to become a legendary tracker whose targets rarely escape his blades.
Broodmother: Black Arachnia protects her growing brood with ruthless cunning and a hunger for intruders.
Clinkz: The archer Clinkz was cursed with undeath after slaying a powerful demon, leaving his bones eternally aflame.
Drow Ranger: Traxex was raised among the Drow, mastering the bow while remaining an outsider to their people.
Ember Spirit: Xin is an ancient warrior spirit whose fire and discipline live on beyond his mortal life.
Faceless Void: Darkterror comes from a realm outside normal time, wielding power over moments and destiny.
Gyrocopter: Aurel built a flying war machine, taking his inventions into battle after years of dangerous experimentation.
Hoodwink: A clever woodland outlaw, Hoodwink protects her forest with traps, acorns and a deadly crossbow.
Juggernaut: Yurnero, the last of a masked order, roams the world after the destruction of his homeland.
Kez: A rebellious birdlike swordsman, Kez defies tyranny using daring footwork and paired blades.
Lone Druid: Sylla guards the natural world alongside a loyal spirit bear, drawing on ancient druidic powers.
Luna: Once a ruthless warrior, Luna found a new purpose serving Selemene as the Moon Rider.
Medusa: To save her sisters, Medusa surrendered her beauty and became a fearsome, serpent-haired guardian.
Meepo: Meepo is a resourceful scavenger from the Riftshadow Ruins who can mysteriously appear in several places at once.
Mirana: Princess Mirana abandoned royal privilege to serve Selemene and patrol the Nightsilver Woods.
Monkey King: Sun Wukong, a mischievous immortal, challenged the heavens before taking his tricks into the mortal world.
Morphling: A shapeshifting elemental arrived from the stars and learned to imitate the beings of this world.
Naga Siren: Slithice seeks to reclaim honor after a sacred artifact was stolen from her undersea people.
Phantom Assassin: Mortred belongs to the secretive Sisters of the Veil, carrying out killings guided by mysterious prophecy.
Phantom Lancer: Azwraith discovered his power to split into illusions during a desperate battle against overwhelming foes.
Razor: The Lightning Revenant is a merciless warden of the Narrow Maze, herding souls through the afterlife.
Riki: The lone survivor of a royal house, Riki now works in shadow as a swift and silent assassin.
Shadow Fiend: Nevermore gathers the souls of those he kills, storing countless stolen essences in his sinister form.
Slark: Escaping the infamous Dark Reef prison, Slark became an elusive thief and deadly ambusher.
Sniper: Kardel Sharpeye was exiled from his mountain people after a perfect shot fulfilled a terrifying prophecy.
Spectre: Mercurial drifts between dimensions, struggling to understand the mortal world she invades.
Templar Assassin: Lanaya searches ancient temples for hidden knowledge, following secrets that promise unimaginable power.
Terrorblade: An outcast demon who stole power from his own reflection, Terrorblade seeks to reshape reality.
Troll Warlord: Jah’rakal's rage and obsession with proving himself drove him from his people into endless battle.
Ursa: Ulfsaar is a proud bear warrior who fights to defend his cubs and the sacred lands of his clan.
Vengeful Spirit: Shendelzare, betrayed by her sister and stripped of her wings, returned as a spirit bent on vengeance.
Viper: A venomous creature from the Nether Reaches, Viper escaped captivity and turned his toxins on the world.
Weaver: Skitskurr once repaired the fabric of reality but now reshapes its threads according to his own whims.
Ancient Apparition: Kaldr is a projection of primordial cold, a force that exists beyond ordinary time and reality.
Chen: Once a ruthless knight, Chen became a devoted convert and now leads others in the name of his faith.
Crystal Maiden: Rylai learned to master her dangerous frost magic under the guidance of a powerful ice wizard.
Dark Seer: Ish’Kafel came from a reality beyond the known world and uses strange energies to reshape battle.
Dark Willow: Mireska escaped the rules of her fairy court and now revels in mischief with her companion Jex.
Disruptor: Thrall uses storms and his people's ancient craft to guide his tribe toward a new future.
Enchantress: Aiushtha is a guardian of the woods whose charm and nature magic shelter innocent creatures.
Grimstroke: Grimstroke's quest for magical mastery brought calamity upon his village and bound him to dark spirits.
Invoker: Carl is an ancient prodigy of spellcraft whose immense memory lets him combine elemental magic with precision.
Jakiro: Born as a rare two-headed dragon, Jakiro combines ice and fire with destructive harmony.
Keeper of the Light: Ezalor is a manifestation of primordial light, eternally riding against forces of darkness.
Leshrac: Leshrac saw the terrifying nature of reality and was transformed into a being of chaotic energy.
Lich: Ethreain, once a powerful sorcerer, was frozen and entombed only to return as an undead master of frost.
Lina: Rylai's fiery sister, Lina, commands explosive flames and has never been known for restraint.
Lion: A once-proud sorcerer, Lion was twisted by a journey through hell and returned with monstrous powers.
Muerta: Muerta crosses the boundary between the living and the dead, bringing supernatural justice with her pistols.
Necrophos: Rotund’jere rose from plague-stricken lands, embracing decay as a tool of terrible power.
Oracle: Nerif sees possible futures, but every prophecy he speaks can change the events it foretells.
Outworld Devourer: Harbinger watches the universe from beyond its borders, wielding powers that mortals can scarcely comprehend.
Puck: A playful faerie dragon, Puck can turn even the smallest prank into a dangerous magical encounter.
Pugna: Raised among the disciples of an ancient nether order, Pugna quickly became a master of draining magic.
Queen of Pain: Akasha escaped torment and became a demon who delights in inflicting exquisite pain.
Ringmaster: Creepy circus impresario Cogliostro Kettle draws unsuspecting victims into his lethal performances.
Rubick: The Grand Magus is a brilliant spell thief, able to imitate magic after seeing it cast.
Shadow Demon: A scheming demon, Shadow Demon manipulates the souls and desires of others in pursuit of dominion.

Silencer: Nortrom was born to a magical bloodline but made his name by mastering the power to suppress spells.
Skywrath Mage: Dragonus serves the Skywrath throne, secretly hoping to save the woman he once loved.
Storm Spirit: Raijin Thunderkeg is the exuberant embodiment of a storm spirit bound to a mortal host.
Tinker: Boush survived a disastrous experiment and now battles with inventions fueled by restless curiosity.
Warlock: Demnok Lannik studies forbidden tomes and commands dark powers through terrifying infernal pacts.
Winter Wyvern: Auroth is a learned elder dragon who guards ancient lore and wields a chilling song of winter.
Witch Doctor: Zharvakko is an eccentric healer whose strange rituals can heal allies or curse enemies.
Zeus: Cast down from the heavens, Zeus seeks to prove he remains worthy of his divine powers.
Abaddon: The Lord of Avernus draws strength from a mysterious mist that shelters his family’s ancestral estate.
Arc Warden: Zet is the last warden of the primordial fragments, struggling to reunite forces that divided creation.
Bane: Atropos was born from the nightmares of a goddess, giving him dominion over mortal fears and sleep.
Batrider: A daring rider tamed a monstrous bat and now uses flame and speed to terrorize foes from above.
Beastmaster: Karroch escaped a cruel menagerie and formed a deep bond with the wild creatures of the world.
Brewmaster: Mangix is a wandering monk who combines martial discipline with the chaotic power of elemental spirits.
Dazzle: Dazzle entered the Nothl Realm and returned with forbidden magic that blurs life and death.
Death Prophet: Krobelus repeatedly sought answers from death and came back haunted by spirits from the other side.
Enigma: A living force of gravity, Enigma bends matter and space to his inscrutable cosmic will.
Io: A wandering fundamental spirit, Io forms luminous bonds with allies while moving between distant places.
Magnus: Magnoceros left his people’s underground kingdom when war threatened their ancient home.
Marci: A fiercely loyal protector, Marci uses her strength to defend Mirana and those close to her.
Nature’s Prophet: Furion was chosen by the goddess of nature to protect forests and the balance of the world.
Nyx Assassin: A chosen servant of the goddess Nyx, the assassin strikes enemies with devotion and deadly precision.
Pangolier: Donte Panlin is a charming duelist who embraces danger, glory and adventure wherever he travels.
Sand King: Crixalis is an embodiment of the living desert, commanding the sands that gave him form.
Snapfire: Beatrix Snapfire rides her lizard Mortimer, trading baked treats and explosive ammunition in equal measure.
Techies: Squee, Spleen and Spoon are explosive-loving inventors whose experiments rarely leave anything standing.
Venomancer: Lesale Deathbringer became infused with toxic substances, transforming into a walking plague.
Visage: Necro'lic is a grim guardian of the afterlife’s entrance, hunting souls that escape their destined path.
Void Spirit: Inai is one of the mysterious spirit brothers, observing the mortal world from the hidden realm beyond.
